_comment: /chosen of the macOS 27.0.1 guest (make-droidvm-adt.py --adt-table; board.toml [os_overrides."macos-27.0.1-26A434".payload.adt]), as upstream UniXNU's macOS profile writes its [adt.chosen] (14236be). boot-uuid and apfs-preboot-uuid: the booted System volume, the OS image's (the OS profile's [root] os_volume_uuid), which kern.bootuuid and kern.apfsprebootuuid answer and launchd, logd and dyld look /System/Volumes/Preboot/<uuid> up by. board-id: VirtualMac2,1's ApBoardID (0x20; chip-id 0xFE00 is [payload.adt] chip_id). asmb: the local boot policy csr_bootstrap reads, lp-sip0 = 0 keeping every SIP protection and lp-sip1 = 1 adding CSR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ROOT, as `csrutil authenticated-root disable` does: the system volume carries no Apple seal manifest here, the owner-signed root policies verify every block of it. arm-io/display: IOMobileFramebuffer.framework (iomfb_populate_all_display_infos) counts the framebuffers to wait for by the DisplayPortCount of the AppleParavirtGPU services when an /arm-io child is compatible paravirtualizedgraphics,gpu, as on a virtual Mac; DroidVMDisplay's AppleParavirtGPU (the collection has no Apple one) is that node's nub and the display's provider.
